text: I do not give trade instructions or sizing; that decision is yours, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. What the pack shows: the WTI release-day return per 1 sd crude surprise is -0.3481% (t -5.7945, since 2001), which is contemporaneous and predicts nothing about the surprise itself. The day-before slope is also -0.177 per sd, so part of the reaction happens before the release (inference).
